dialogue.english: I am the Monkey King! Let's play!

cards.english: The Monkey King guards the Peach Garden.
Sweet pink peaches glow in the clouds.

dialogue.english: Wow! This garden is huge and bright!
Welcome, Great Sage! Please take good care.

cards.english: The Earth God shows three magic trees.
The biggest peaches take nine thousand years.

dialogue.english: One bite gives endless health and joy!
dialogue.twFullText: 吃一口就能長生不老喔！

dialogue.english: Nine thousand years? They must taste amazing!

cards.english: The Monkey King cannot wait any longer.
cards.twFullText: 悟空忍不住爬上大桃樹。

cards.english: He picks the ripest, sweetest golden peaches.

dialogue.english: Yum! So juicy and sweet! One more!
dialogue.twFullText: 真香！又甜又多汁！再來一個！

dialogue.english: Golden peach mist fills the sunny sky.

cards.english: Full and happy, he naps on a branch.
cards.twFullText: 吃飽以後，他在樹枝打盹。

cards.english: Soon, seven fairies glide down with baskets.
cards.twFullText: 七位仙女提著花籃飛來。

dialogue.english: Zzz, what a cozy afternoon nap!
Let's pick fresh peaches for the Peach Banquet!

cards.english: The red fairy reaches for a peach.
Pop! Out jumps the playful Monkey King!
cards.twFullText: 砰！調皮大聖突然跳出來！

dialogue.english: Oh! Great Sage, you startled us!
Hey! Who told you to pick my peaches?
dialogue.twFullText: 嗨！是誰讓你們來摘桃的？

cards.english: The Queen Mother holds a grand banquet.
cards.twFullText: 王母娘娘要辦蟠桃盛會。

cards.english: Wait! The Monkey King was not invited!

dialogue.english: Sorry, Great Sage! Your name wasn't listed.
dialogue.twFullText: 抱歉大聖，名單裡沒有您。

dialogue.english: Not invited? That's not fair at all!
dialogue.twFullText: 竟然不請我？太不公平啦！

cards.english: The Monkey King waves his magic hand.
cards.twFullText: 悟空揮手施展神奇法術。

cards.english: Sparkling light freezes the fairies in place!
cards.twFullText: 金光閃閃把仙女定住啦！

dialogue.english: Stay right there! I'll visit the banquet!
dialogue.twFullText: 先別動！我去盛會瞧一瞧！

dialogue.english: Hey! Come back and undo the spell!
dialogue.twFullText: 喂！快回來幫我們解開呀！

cards.english: He leaps onto his golden Somersault Cloud.
cards.twFullText: 他跳上金光閃閃筋斗雲。

cards.english: Laughing loudly, the Monkey King zooms away!
cards.twFullText: 美猴王大笑著飛向雲端！

dialogue.english: Haha! Time for a grand sky adventure!
dialogue.twFullText: 哈哈！天空大冒險出發啦！

dialogue.english: The grand Yaochi Banquet awaits ahead!
dialogue.twFullText: 前方就是熱鬧的瑤池盛會！
